newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks open higher on blue chips buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks open higher on blue chips buying.

text.p: Pakistan stocks rose in early trade on Tuesday on buying by foreign funds mainly in Hub Power and telecom utility PTCL shares, brokers said.
The rally would continue in the near-term, they said.
"The interest of foreign funds focused in about a dozen blue chips even at these high levels," dealer Usama Shoaib said. "The index is likely to stay at these levels."

The index rose 23.65 points, or 1.17 percent, to 2,049.06 in the first 50 minutes of trade. Gainers beat losers 75 to 27. PTCL rose 0.75 rupees to 43.35 and Hub Power 1.85 to 60.10. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192.
